greetings.text: If it needs iron, say so. If it needs miracles, go to Church.
Back already? Show me what cracked.
You treat your gear like it matters. I notice.
The anvil’s quiet. City Hall isn’t. Get me out or take your business to Rulda.
Paperwork’s a shackle, but the forge is hot again. Keep it legal here; we can talk… elsewhere.
Keep it quiet and keep it moving. Sparks travel faster than rumors.
